actions.label: Review programme permission upgrade
actions.confirmation: I am the active original programme creator. Adopt only these signed-module permission additions: program.finance, program.fund. Existing case/team grants and intentionally removed rights remain unchanged.

actions.label: Revoke programme access
actions.confirmation: Revoke this account’s programme and case access? Other programme access remains unchanged.

actions.label: Revoke case access
actions.confirmation: Remove only this case assignment? Programme membership remains unchanged.

actions.label: Approve and seal resource statement
actions.confirmation: I reviewed the organizational authority, restrictions, exact cash states and fixed reporting period. No external money movement is executed; this statement will become immutable.

actions.label: Reconcile rejected training request
actions.confirmation: I reviewed the terminal rejected reservation and retained receipt. This closes only that rejected attempt; a new training choice, disclosure and eligibility review are required. Uncertain or accepted reservations cannot be reset.
